text: Cars are moving into the opposite lane to avoid a damaged section of road.
A small crack is visible near the edge of the road, but vehicles are passing normally.
Motorcycles are losing balance when crossing the damaged road surface.
The road has a network of interconnected cracks near the market.
A part of the road has sunk and drivers are slowing down to pass it.
The road surface is uneven near the entrance of the residential area.
There is a broken drainage cover on the road near the hospital.
A wide crack crosses the road and causes vehicles to brake suddenly.
